introduce:
Stand in front of a chair with your feet hip-with apart. Hold the chair back with your hands. 

Slowly step back and lower your chest towards the floor. Pull your hips away from the chair. 

Don't bend your knees and press your heels on the floor. Transfer your weight into your feet. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR DOWNWARD FACING DOG

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Take deep and steady breaths.
This pose stretches your spine, shoulders and legs.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs a little wider than shoulder-with apart. Place your hands on the floor between your feet.

Inhale, twist your body to the left and reach your left arm towards the ceiling. 

Take your gaze to your left hand. Exhale, return and repeat with the other side.
name: CHAIR REVOLVED FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Don't hold your breath, maintain regular breathing.
This exercise stretches your back and increases the flexibility of your shoulders.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs shoulder-with apart and your feet flat on the floor.

Roll your shoulders back. Interlock your fingers behind you.

Exhale, fold your body forward, extending your arms as you move them forward. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR FORWARD BEND WITH SHOULDER OPENER

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Don't hold your breath, maintain regular breathing.
Keep your neck relaxed.
This exercise helps increase the mobility of your shoulders.

introduce:
Prepare a chair without armrests where your feet can touch the floor when sitting. 

Sit on the edge of the chair. Inhale, open your left leg out towards the left. Make sure your knee is aligned with your ankle, pointing in the same direction as your toes and forming a 90-degree angle.

Exhale, extend your right leg to the right with your toes facing forward. Raise your arms to your sides at shoulder height with your palms down.

Draw your belly in, tuck your tailbone down, and lift your chest. Take your gaze to your left hand. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR WARRIOR II LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Don't let your bent knee go over your toes.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and keep them relaxed.
This exercise strengthens your lower body and shoulders.
